population.value: patients with ischemic heart disease (ischemic heart failure) at department of cardiology, Fayoum University

intervention.value: Combination of Dapagliflozin (10 mg) daily and statin (Atorvastatin 40 mg or Rosuvastatin 40 mg) daily (GPIII, n = 21)

comparator.value: SGLT2i group (GPI, n = 26) taking Dapagliflozin 10 mg daily; Statin group (GPII, n = 34) taking Atorvastatin 40 mg or Rosuvastatin 40 mg daily

primary_findings.quote: Group: III showed no adverse effects, maintained stable drug levels as the mean was 7.3 ng/ml and SD was 4.4 ng/ml (p-value 0.66)
primary_findings.outcome: Trough plasma drug concentration (stable drug levels)

limitations_stated.quote: though larger studies are needed to confirm
